zh.title: 法國空天軍於兩座民用機場操作Rafale與CN235
zh.summary: 法國空天軍在BASEX演習期間於兩座民用機場操作Rafale與CN235。
body: French Air and Space Force在BASEX演習期間，於兩座民用機場操作三架Rafale戰機及兩架CASA CN235運輸機。演習於France各地自September 23至October 2, 2026舉行；部署地點為Pau Pyrénées Airport（PUF）與Dinard Airport（DNR），行動依據FRA-ACE進行。
三架Rafale戰機從Air Base 118 Mont-de-Marsan部署至Pau，隨行人員約25人。CN235機組從Dinard執行訓練飛行，包括爆裂物處理演練，以及與機場消防救援服務的聯合演練。French Air and Space Force表示，兩項部署均與機場主管機關及營運單位協調，以避免幹擾正常航班及商業活動。

en.title: France’s Air and Space Force operates Rafale and CN235 aircraft from civilian airports
en.summary: France’s Air and Space Force operated Rafale and CN235 aircraft from two civilian airports during BASEX.
body: The French Air and Space Force operated three Rafale fighters and two CASA CN235 transport aircraft from two civilian airports during BASEX. The exercise ran across France from September 23 to October 2, 2026. Deployments to Pau Pyrénées Airport (PUF) and Dinard Airport (DNR) were conducted under FRA-ACE, France’s adaptation of NATO’s Agile Combat Employment concept.

Three Rafale fighters from the 30th Fighter Wing at Air Base 118 Mont-de-Marsan deployed to Pau with about 25 personnel. CN235 crews flew training sorties from Dinard, including an explosive ordnance disposal exercise and a joint drill with the airport’s fire and rescue services. The service said both deployments were coordinated with airport authorities and operators to avoid disrupting normal flight operations and commercial activity.

zh.title: King Khalid International Airport 逾八成離場航班受阻
zh.summary: King Khalid International Airport 10月15日逾八成離場航班受阻
body: King Khalid International Airport（利雅德）10月15日預定處理366班離場航班，其中298班列為取消或未執飛，受影響比例為81.4%。
報導指出，沙烏地阿拉伯民航總局本週稍早延長機場營運暫停，以便持續進行安全檢查；該機關尚未宣佈何時恢復正常服務。
國泰航空已將利雅德與杜拜航班恢復日期延後至2027年1月31日。菲律賓航空本月稍早暫停利雅德服務，並表示不計畫在11月29日前恢復營運。

en.title: King Khalid International Airport records 81.4% disrupted departures
en.summary: King Khalid International Airport recorded 81.4% disrupted departures on 15 October.
body: King Khalid International Airport was scheduled to handle 366 departing flights on 15 October. Cirium data cited by Aerospace Global News recorded 298 as cancelled or no-fly, a disruption rate of 81.4%.

The report said Saudi Arabia’s General Authority of Civil Aviation had extended the suspension of airport operations earlier in the week to allow safety inspections to continue. The authority had not announced when normal services would resume.

Cathay Pacific postponed the resumption of Riyadh and Dubai flights until 31 January 2027. Philippine Airlines suspended Riyadh services earlier this month and did not plan to resume operations until 29 November.
